clauses.statement: labeled contains entries across sampled subject–benchmark pairs
Exactly eight plain-string subject fields, missing empty string
item_content, item_features, interactors, anonymous stable benchmark_id; item_id absent
0,1,3,7,15,31 per pair; nested trajectory; same evaluation items
50/50 items per pair; all repeated responses stay with item; evaluation outcomes never revealed
Identical subject/item input reuses one probability for repeats
Official empirical mean matches complete subject dict and benchmark_id
No executable hosted runner or actual evidence sample obtained
No guaranteed same-benchmark peer cohort or selection distribution
Multi-pair schema permits it, but actual calls and timing not observed
Per-pair split is explicit; cross-subject item overlap rules are not
Do not assume call order or persistent state, including across budgets
Identical text can differ in features/interactors; internal item_id unavailable
Never infer unseen labels from historical IDs or hidden evaluation outcomes

minimum_contract.matching: exact canonical tuple of all visible item fields; exact subject dict equality
minimum_contract.peer_labels: only supplied current-budget acquisition labels; never evaluation response of that peer
minimum_contract.simulation: 0/1/3 distinct visible peers, deterministic attribute-only assignment; conditional_simulation
